lead.title: Edinburgh's Bioliberty closes a $3.3M Series A extension for its soft robotic stroke-rehab glove
lead.deck: Four new investors — TGH Ventures, Ballad Ventures, 25M Health and Whiterock — join the round eight months after the Series A led by the Scottish National Investment Bank. The Scottish company, whose Lifeglov glove and Lifehub platform are FDA-registered, is pushing its US commercialization.

milestone.title: Baird Medical and Alpmed file their irreversible electroporation (IRE) system with the FDA and in Europe for CE marking
milestone.summary: The partners submitted an FDA 510(k) and an EU CE conformity assessment application for a non-thermal IRE tissue ablation system, already marketed in China for liver and pancreatic tumors. Baird Medical holds worldwide commercial rights and targets clearance and CE marking in 2027.
milestone.why: IRE destroys tumors without heat, useful near sensitive structures that thermal ablation handles poorly. The CE filing signals an Asian player entering European ablation, a comparable for European electroporation startups.

brefsEurope.title: Israel's movement group buys the technology and IP of Swiss dacadoo, a company in liquidation
brefsEurope.summary: The buyer takes the software, source code and 51 patents of the health-engagement platform founded in 2010 and used by insurers and large employers; dacadoo ag is in liquidation and customers keep access. Price undisclosed: a reminder that B2B2C health engagement struggles to stand alone.

brefsEurope.title: Siemens Healthineers prepares to separate its in vitro diagnostics unit, renamed Olyrian Diagnostics, by mid-2028
brefsEurope.summary: Shareholder vote expected in February 2027; the IVD business, hit by China's decline (comparable sales −5.5% in Q3, close to €1bn), targets a further €400M in savings. The group will pay Siemens €300M for the brand transition to “Healthineers”.

brefsIntl.title: PulseAI wins FDA clearance for its wearable arrhythmia analysis model
brefsIntl.summary: In a prospective study of 296 participants, the algorithm improved atrial fibrillation detection and cut inconclusive readings by 92% versus the Apple Watch's native algorithm.

brefsIntl.title: Abbott starts the pivotal trial of its Cephea transcatheter mitral valve, with up to 585 patients in the US, Canada and Europe
brefsIntl.summary: First patient enrolled in Wichita (Kansas); the trial covers moderate-to-severe mitral regurgitation and mitral annular calcification. A comparable for European mitral replacement startups.

word.definition: A motorized orthosis worn on the body that assists or guides a patient's movement (walking, hand function) to relearn movement after a stroke or spinal cord injury.

parts.label: Structure and actuators
parts.role: the motorized joints that assist movement

parts.label: Sensors and control
parts.role: detect the patient's intent and balance and adjust assistance

parts.label: Clinical software
parts.role: sets up the session and tracks progress for the therapist

how.t: The therapist sets the assistance level for the impairment (spinal cord injury, stroke, multiple sclerosis).
Actuators repeatedly guide the movement (steps, hand opening/closing) while the patient participates.
Session data measures progress and lets the therapy be adapted, in clinic and then at home.

word.why: VC angle: a regulated market (CE/MDR, FDA) with recurring revenue per machine placed in centers, and a shift toward home use and soft exosuits — lighter and cheaper — that widens the addressable market.

startups.name: Wandercraft
